text:
marta: Quick thread to finalize the observability slices for the console release. Sales asks: per-route cost (tokens + embeddings), error analytics with trace links, and a low-cost tracing hook. Need owners and M1/M2 split.

vik: Proposal: M1 = compact "cost by route" widget + error buckets (drop/retry/timeout) + trace-id links to samples. M2 = org-level sampling slider, per-route overrides, and optional full-span ingestion. Reason: cost attribution unblocks buyers.

oliver: Engineering note: full-span = 3-4x storage. Suggest trace-index approach: store trace metadata and top spans; full-span fetch on-demand if org enables. Adds an infra ticket but keeps steady telemetry costs.

rachel: UX: widget should show top 10 routes by spend, quick filter by model and date (7d/30d). Drilldown shows example traces with CTA "request full span". I'll post compact mocks in Figma.

marta: Acceptance checklist draft:
```
- Cost widget: per-route token_count, embedding_count, est $ cost; default windows 7d/30d
- Error analytics: grouped by class, show top routes and sample trace ids
- Trace hook: annotated server spans emitted for sampled requests; trace id surfaced in error details
- Retention: trace-index 90d, full-span 7d default
- Rollout: canary to 3 pilot orgs for 1 week; telemetry cost delta <25% to proceed
- Tests: synthetic prompts + cost smoke tests
```

vik: +1. I'll create runtime ticket for annotated spans (RUNTIME-7001). infra-bot: can you create the trace-index storage ticket?

infra-bot: Created INF-7102: trace-index path + retention tiers.

oliver: Add auto-guard: if telemetry spend for org increases >30% vs baseline, auto-disable full-span for that org and notify account owner.

marta: Who owns rollout playbook and Dedicated SLA wording?

rachel: Ill own the playbook + UI copy for the widget and drilldowns.

vik: I'll own backend API and sampling flags. Oliver takes runtime and infra followups.

marta: Decision: ship M1 (cost widget + trace-index + error buckets) for release; M2 deferred. If no objections by EOD, mark as roadmap commit. :rocket:
